cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(go1_imu_timestamp)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(gazebo_ros REQUIRED)
find_package(sensor_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(gazebo_dev REQUIRED)
find_package(gazebo_plugins REQUIRED)
link_directories(${gazebo_dev_LIBRARY_DIRS})
add_library(gazebo_ros_imu_sensor SHARED gazebo_ros_imu_sensor.cpp)
set_target_properties(gazebo_ros_imu_sensor PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17)
ament_target_dependencies(gazebo_ros_imu_sensor gazebo_ros sensor_msgs gazebo_dev gazebo_plugins)
target_link_libraries(gazebo_ros_imu_sensor ImuSensorPlugin)
